item.title: Manu Bhaker Secures Silver for India at the 2026 Asian Shooting Championship
item.description: GUWAHATI: Olympic double bronze medallist Manu Bhaker suffered a heartbreakingly close defeat but still shone bright at the Asian Rifle/Pistol Championship in New Delhi on Monday, 9 February, clinching silver in the women’s 25m pistol after a tense shoot-off. Vietnam’s Nguyen Thuy Trang held her nerve in the tie-breaker to secure gold after both shooters were locked at 35 points at the end of regulation. item.title: India Ranked 91st in Corruption Index 2025, Scores Lower Than Global Average
item.description: GUWAHATI: India has been placed 91st out of 182 countries and territories in the Corruption Perceptions Index (CPI) 2025, released by Transparency International on February 10. item.description: GUWAHATI: The United States has modified its official factsheet outlining the key provisions of the proposed India–US trade agreement, removing references to tariff cuts on certain agricultural products — including pulses — and softening language on India’s proposed purchases of American goods.
